title: VP Operations
description:
CXO / COO – Fleet \& Logistics Responsibilities

* Led end\-to\-end fleet and transportation operations, covering fleet acquisition, deployment, utilization, maintenance, driver management, and customer service.
* Developed and executed fleet and logistics strategies aligned with business growth, profitability, customer SLAs, and geographic expansion.
* Owned operational P\&L with responsibility for revenue growth, contribution margins, cost optimization, and overall business performance.
* Built and managed scalable fleet networks by onboarding, developing, and retaining fleet owners, transporters, OEMs, and logistics partners.
* Managed relationships with large enterprise customers, OEMs, transport partners, fleet aggregators, and strategic business partners.
* Optimized vehicle utilization, turnaround time, load factor, route planning, empty\-run reduction, and fleet productivity through data\-driven decision making.
* Implemented technology\-enabled fleet management using GPS, telematics, mobility platforms, dashboards, and real\-time operational analytics.
* Established performance KPIs for fleet utilization, vehicle availability, on\-time delivery, turnaround time, fuel efficiency, maintenance cost, and customer satisfaction.
* Led digital transformation initiatives to improve vehicle tracking, trip allocation, dispatch planning, driver engagement, payment processes, and operational visibility.
* Developed strategic pricing and commercial models for transportation services, balancing customer requirements, market conditions, fleet partner economics, and company profitability.
* Drove cost reduction initiatives across fuel, maintenance, tolls, manpower, vehicle downtime, vendor charges, and other operating expenses.
* Built strong fleet\-partner ecosystems through transparent commercial models, timely payments, incentive programs, and performance\-based engagement.
* Led fleet expansion and asset\-light/asset\-heavy business models based on market demand and business requirements.
* Managed preventive and predictive maintenance programs to improve vehicle uptime, reliability, and lifecycle economics.
* Established safety and compliance frameworks covering driver safety, vehicle fitness, insurance, permits, statutory documentation, and regulatory requirements.
* Developed and implemented driver productivity, training, retention, incentive, and safety programs.
* Led cross\-functional teams across operations, fleet, technology, finance, sales, customer service, procurement, HR, and maintenance.
* Managed regional and multi\-location operations with responsibility for operational excellence and consistent service delivery.
* Identified new business opportunities and developed strategic partnerships to expand fleet capacity, customer base, and geographical coverage.
* Negotiated strategic contracts with OEMs, fuel providers, maintenance partners, insurance companies, fleet owners, and logistics service providers.
* Established MIS and executive dashboards for real\-time monitoring of revenue, fleet productivity, utilization, profitability, customer SLA, and operational KPIs.
* Led continuous improvement and transformation initiatives to improve scalability, customer experience, operational efficiency, and profitability.
* Developed annual operating plans, budgets, manpower plans, fleet investment strategies, and long\-term growth plans.
* Worked closely with the CEO/Board/Investors to review business performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive strategic initiatives.
* Built a high\-performance leadership culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, customer centricity, and profitable growth.

Pay: ₹873,010\.59 \- ₹2,181,225\.23 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This is a contract role  

  

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment, strong relationship\-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time\-off, payments, and work\-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de\-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp\-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third\-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave \& Disability management role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Sailpoint
description:
**Role description**  


Role Summary


The SailPoint IAM Platform Engineer will design, integrate, administer, secure, and support the SailPoint identity platform and its connected enterprise applications. The role combines application onboarding, identity lifecycle automation, Linux and application\-server administration, vulnerability mitigation, high availability, disaster recovery, and audit support. The engineer will help ensure reliable provisioning and deprovisioning, least\-privilege access, secure connectivity, and timely access revocation for employees, contractors, and third\-party users.


Key Responsibilities


1\. SailPoint Integration \& Application Onboarding


* Lead end\-to\-end onboarding and integration of enterprise applications into SailPoint IAM.
* Configure and support identity aggregation, account correlation, access profiles, entitlements, provisioning, deprovisioning, and reconciliation.
* Partner with application owners, HR, infrastructure, security, and audit teams to capture requirements, define controls, test integrations, and transition solutions into production.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
2\. Enterprise Systems in Scope


* WMS and workforce or warehouse management systems.
* SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
* Master Data Management platforms.
* Active Directory and LDAP directories.
* Electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign and Adobe Acrobat Sign.
* HR platforms and other authoritative sources that trigger identity lifecycle events.
3\. Identity Lifecycle \& Process Enhancement


* Design, enhance, and streamline identity lifecycle processes for joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, and third\-party users.
* Integrate SailPoint with HR systems and authoritative sources to trigger lifecycle events accurately and consistently.
* Automate access provisioning and deprovisioning in line with least\-privilege principles and approved access policies.
* Ensure timely revocation of access for leavers, terminated personnel, and expired contractors.
* Continuously fine\-tune workflows, rules, approvals, exception handling, and operational controls to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.
4\. Linux \& SailPoint Platform Administration


* Administer Linux environments, with strong hands\-on expertise in Oracle Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
* Manage SailPoint application servers and Tomcat, including JVM tuning, service configuration, performance optimization, and log management.
* Perform operating\-system\-level troubleshooting, capacity monitoring, root\-cause analysis, and performance tuning.
* Administer file systems, permissions, scheduled jobs and cron jobs, system services, and platform certificates.
* Maintain secure communication between SailPoint and connected target systems.
5\. Vulnerability Mitigation, Security \& Compliance


* Review and remediate vulnerabilities identified through OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or equivalent tools.
* Plan and apply SailPoint patches, hotfixes, and third\-party library upgrades using controlled change and validation procedures.
* Perform operating\-system hardening aligned with applicable CIS Benchmarks and organizational security standards.
* Manage TLS/SSL certificates, keystores, truststores, renewals, and certificate\-related incident resolution.
* Support ISO, SOC, internal security, and customer audit reviews by providing evidence, remediation updates, and control documentation.
* Follow security, change, incident, problem, and release management practices.
6\. High Availability, Resilience \& Disaster Recovery


* Configure, operate, and support SailPoint high\-availability architecture hosted in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Manage clustering, load balancing, node health, failover behavior, and availability monitoring.
* Coordinate disaster recovery activities, recovery validation, and periodic failover testing.
* Monitor platform health, availability, performance, interfaces, queues, logs, and scheduled jobs; take proactive corrective action.
* Participate in production support, major incident resolution, and after\-hours support as required by the operating model.
Required Skills \& Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience with SailPoint application integration, connector configuration, application onboarding, and identity lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience administering enterprise SailPoint environments and supporting production operations.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, particularly Oracle Linux and RHEL.
* Hands\-on experience with Tomcat administration, JVM tuning, log analysis, certificate management, file systems, and cron scheduling.
* Experience remediating infrastructure and application vulnerabilities using OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with HA, clustering, load balancing, failover, disaster recovery, and health monitoring in OCI or a comparable cloud environment.
* Working knowledge of IAM principles, least privilege, access governance, segregation of duties, provisioning, deprovisioning, and audit controls.
* Integration experience with HR systems, Active Directory/LDAP, SAP, MDM, WMS, and SaaS applications through standard connectors, APIs, or secure file interfaces.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and production\-support skills.
Education \& Certification


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Professional credential or SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer certification is required or strongly preferred, based on the final hiring level.
* Additional Linux, cloud, security, ITIL, or IAM certifications are advantageous.
Preferred Technical Exposure


* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and/or IdentityIQ.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Linux shell scripting, REST APIs, web services, JDBC, SCIM, and directory integrations.
* Monitoring, ticketing, source control, CI/CD, and enterprise change\-management tools.
* Security baselines, vulnerability management, certificate lifecycle management, and compliance evidence preparation.
Key Competencies


* Ownership and accountability for platform reliability and secure operations.
* Structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Risk awareness and disciplined change execution.
* Collaboration across HR, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, and audit teams.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and operational resilience.

title: Workday HCM/Security and Recruiting Senior Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**

The Workday HCM, Recruiting \& Security Analyst is responsible for functional leadership, solution design, administration, optimization, and ongoing ownership of Workday HCM, Recruiting, and Security as a key member of the Global HR Shared Services team.


This role acts as a Workday strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence, HR Shared Services, business stakeholders, HR Product Owners, IT, and downstream technology teams. The role will translate business requirements into scalable Workday solutions, leveraging configuration, process design, and practical workarounds to address complex business needs.


The successful candidate will bring prior Workday implementation and /o r consulting experience, with the ability to connect the dots across the technology ecosystem, understand downstream impacts, and design solutions that balance business needs, system capabilities, user experience, and long\-term sustainability.


This position will lead and contribute to Workday enhancements, implementations, organizational changes, releases, and special projects.


Reporting to the HR Shared Services Leader, this role combines Workday sec urity expertise , funct ional knowle dge, solution architecture, business partnership, implementation experience, and leadership thinking to continuously improve the HR technology landscape.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday HCM**

* Own the functional design and optimization of Workday HCM business processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable Workday solutions.
* Evaluate Workday functionality and develop configuration\-based solutions and practical workarounds where standard functionality does not fully meet business needs.
* Connect requirements across Workday modules and consider upstream and downstream impacts when designing solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR Product Owners and business stakeholders on Workday capabilities, limitations, and solution options.
**Workday Security**

* Serve as a functional SME for Workday Security, ensuring solutions align with business requirements, organizational structures, and governance standards.
* Design and implement Workday security solutions in conjunction with HCM and other module business processes, with strong knowledge of Workday security group types, including Intersection, Aggregation, and Mixed security groups, and their application in designing complex access requirements.
* Assess the impact of organizational and business process changes on security and recommend appropriate solutions .
* Apply a solution architect mindset across functional areas , considering the broader Workday ecosystem rather than individual modules in isolation.
* Identify dependencies and downstream impacts and proactively engage the appropriate stakeholders .
**Special Projects \& Business Transformation**

* Lead and participate in Workday enhancements, implementations, organizational changes, and strategic HR technology initiatives across the solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Assess the impact of organizational changes and business priorities across modules. Lead UAT, regression, release testing, and implementation activities.
* HCM and Security, Recruiting and exposure to Compensation is considered a strong advantage
* Evaluate solution options and drive delivery by balancing business needs, user experience, scalability, and sustainability while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience working with Workday HCM and Security preferably in a Workday implementation or consulting environment .
* Workday certifications in HCM is a must and any Advanced Modules is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with Workday implementations, enhancements, configuration projects, or complex solution design.
* Experience translating business requirements into Workday functional solutions and developing configuration\-based workarounds.
* Experience with Workday Recruiting configuration, business processes, supporting Business as Usual, releases, and deployment activities.
* Strong understanding of cross\-functional dependencies between Workday modules and downstream technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently assess complex requirements and recommend solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt solutions to changing business needs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence global stakeholders.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of Workday Compensation and related business processes .
* Experience designing solutions across multiple Workday modules.
* Experience supporting organizational restructuring, business transformation, or significant changes in business processes.
**Who we are:**

Mold\-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co\-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold\-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.  



  

Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission\-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.

Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. title: Functional Consultant-D365 HR
description:
Are you a passionate and enthusiastic Dynamics 365 HR professional looking to build your career in HR digital transformation and enterprise application consulting?


Join LevelShift as a **Functional Consultant Dynamics 365 HR**, where you'll help organizations streamline and transform their HR processes by implementing and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources. You'll collaborate with HR stakeholders, business users, technical teams, and solution architects to understand existing HR processes, perform fit\-gap analysis, and deliver scalable HR solutions.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


As a **Functional Consultant Dynamics 365 HR** at LevelShift, you will:


* Engage with HR stakeholders and business users to understand existing HR processes, business requirements, and system challenges.
* Conduct requirement gathering, process analysis, and fit\-gap analysis to identify the best Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Analyze existing Workday or other HR systems and map their functionality and processes to Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Configure and implement Dynamics 365 HR functionalities based on business requirements and functional design.
* Prepare business requirement documents, functional design documents, process flows, user stories, and other functional documentation.
* Support HR system migration, including data mapping, data migration, validation, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations and the transition of functionality from legacy or third\-party HR applications.
* Work closely with HR stakeholders, business users, architects, and project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, end\-user training, deployment, and post\-implementation activities.
